docs.title: TescoClient
docs.text:
TescoClient is a cheat client for use on EarthMC which allows you to track players and get info about locations.

Install TescoClient Technical Documentation

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
TescoClient is built for the latest fabric loader version and only works on Minecraft Java 1.21.11.

Download latest JAR Github Releases

docs.title: Find command
docs.text: The find command uses the EarthMC map to find players. Squaremap tracks player in the frontend by downloading a file called players.json, which contains the coordinates of every player visible on the map, every few seconds. This file contains coordinates and yaw for every player that is visible on the map and is formatted in JSON.

docs.title: Player tracking
docs.text: Player tracking uses the same endpoints as the find command (above), but reloads it every few seconds to provide live updates.
